plan.title: Counter offer decline and modify options

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product required for bidding.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule.
Invite the QA vendor who will bid and receive the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a bid.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter offer can be initiated.
Send a pending counter offer to the vendor.
Confirm the buyer view marks the counter offer as pending.
Continue in the vendor persona's supplier portal.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer banner is shown.
Confirm the vendor can see the pending counter offer banner.
Choose the vendor's Decline option to open the response dialog.
Verify that the decline dialog opened.
Assert the dialog includes the decline choice.
Assert the dialog offers the required Modify Counter Offer choice.
